snapshot.acme/acme-schema:.github/workflows/valid:
name: validate
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, acme-runner]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx dbtool lint migrations
      - run: npx dbtool push --dry-run
snapshot.acme/acme-schema:.github/workflows/push-:
name: apply
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [migrations/**]
jobs:
  apply:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, acme-runner]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "prepare step 1"
      - run: echo "prepare step 2"
      - run: npx dbtool push --target production

snapshot.acme/acme-infra:docs/ci-rules.md:
# CI rules

- Run the checks locally before you open a pull request.
Rule R1: every job of a PRIVATE repository runs on the self-hosted runner `[self-hosted, acme-runner]`.
Rule R2: a PUBLIC repository may use `ubuntu-latest`, because the self-hosted runner refuses public repositories.
snapshot.acme/acme-infra:deploy/payments.yaml:
service: payments
env:
  - name: PAYMENTS_API_KEY
    from: vault:/payments/PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
  - name: PAYMENTS_REGION
    value: eu-1
